paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: Ferromagnetic haloscope (QUAX prototype) constraining axion-electron coupling g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for m_a = 58 ueV (14 GHz). Limit covers a ~3 MHz scan around 14 GHz but the single quoted value is the minimum. DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Exclusion plot in Fig. 8 shows g_aee vs mass; only the central/best value is given numerically in text.
